Local Outcomes Framework comparator

Where Gateshead stands on MHCLG's Local Outcomes Framework, assembled from each metric's own published source and compared against six switchable groups of authorities. MHCLG publishes no dataset for the framework and its digital tool is not yet live, so every figure here is taken from the original publication the framework names.

Read this first. This is a comparator tool, not an assessment of council performance. Many of these outcomes are shaped mostly by things a council does not control, and several metrics are counts or administrative returns that reflect how an authority records something as much as what it achieves. It is an experimental analytical product, not official statistics: the values are quoted from published official statistics, but the medians, ranks, quintiles and better/worse readings are analytical judgements (analytical assurance note). Metrics come from publishers on different reference periods, stated on every one — this is a compendium, not a snapshot. Where a source publishes a 95% confidence interval, the better/worse reading is a test against the group median; where it does not, only Gateshead's position is shown and no significance is claimed.

What the comparison says, by outcome

Each bar is the series within that outcome. "Position only" means no confidence interval is published, so no significance test is possible. "Not judged" covers metrics the registry withholds a verdict on, metrics with no agreed better direction, and metrics where Gateshead has no published figure.
